script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let part be part 1 of the enemy.
Let list3 be [].
If arg is "3", then
  Append [{messageSuffixNo: "02"}] to list3.
  Append [{deformTag: "deformation_01"}] to list3.
  Append [{builtin: "SET_SA", sa: [the ADJUST_DAMAGE_ZERO_ALL status], saChildNos: [1]}] to list3.
  Append [{builtin: "UNSET_SA", sa: [the INVISIBLE status], saChildNos: [2]}] to list3.
Otherwise, if arg is "4", then
  Append [{deformTag: "deformation_02"}] to list3.
  Append [{builtin: "UNSET_SA", sa: [the ADJUST_DAMAGE_ZERO_ALL status], saChildNos: [1]}] to list3.
Part uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: list3} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.
Part changes to form arg.
Part cancels its cast.
